title: A source change that leaves the revision unchanged neither voids an evaluation nor opens a tests obligation
outcome: A source change that leaves the revision unchanged neither voids an evaluation nor opens a tests obligation
acceptance: A source_changed observation whose source revision equals the last revision recorded on the run neither voids an acceptance evaluation at write time nor makes it stale at done
Such an observation does not open a "tests have not run since your last source change" obligation
Tests cover both, including a same-revision observation that arrives after an evaluation's evidence basis, and a changed revision that still voids and still opens the obligation

completion.summary:
At checkpoint ingestion the core now records source_changed as the host's flag AND NOT a repeated revision. A report repeats when its revision equals the revision of the run's newest recorded source change and no observation or environment evidence recorded since carries a different revision.

Effect:
- A same-revision report (the watcher case for git-ignored writes) no longer voids an evaluation, makes one stale at done, or opens a "tests have not run" obligation.
- A new revision, a revert, or a return after a move still counts.
- Stored observations keep the host's literal flag.
